notes.title: Coffee Talk Characters Mod Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b466899dacaccd2b32c315c67406b04fef6ae6b1.png

Get creative with your favorite Coffee Talk regulars with the Characters Mod!

Greetings, Cafe Regulars.
The additional modding tool for Coffee Talk characters is now released.

Just like in the recent update for Episode 2, the same update also arrived in Coffee Talk. Now, you can mod the game characters by changing the files accordingly. Access to the modding tool is available like other mods that had been implemented such as the localization and the voice-over mod. Change the character's overall outfit, modify their body parts, or add some cool or cute accessories to them!

The workshop tool, with the new characters mod, is out now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/a052dca4c4786481595150f05f957b0424ca97dd.gif

We always listen to our fans and let them express what they have in mind, nurturing their creativity and love towards the characters and the game. With the arrival of the characters' mod update, we hope to brew more creativity for our fans to come up with interesting ideas that we might never have thought of before. If you never touched the mods for Coffee Talk, you can check the workshop documentation for the Coffee Talk series from the link down below. 

Coffee Talk Series Modding Tutorial
Workshop documentation and guide here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/c4071821faf43ee9f070a72b85189890207dcfa5.gif
Freya, with her basic shirt now changed to green, and you can still add more stuff to her! This is just the basic mod of what you can do. 

If you encounter any bugs after the new characters' mod update, don't hesitate to contact us or join our Discord community. You can also reach us from social media to get the latest news of Coffee Talk updates. We will always serve more stuff that you can look forward to!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b04803d97bba2e533ae8ee041af697b669218945.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/79dd3f2effac213f7a4d79409aa7b3a3427c939d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8b1312b21a87946f96f4f0f6eaabe151fe9fa95c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/84fedc2164e8a93f749f967a579a4dd488b8b784.png

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː

notes.title: Release Date Announcement for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/ca156168c8218893e3f39398675b4cdbbfb26c71.jpg

Greetings, Cafe Regulars.

After over two years after the first episode, we are excited to announce the final release date of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly. We have worked hard in the past few months to deliver the best experience, a fully-enhanced coffee-brewing simulation with more stories to unfold. Meet the regulars you all know and love, as well as new charming and quirky regulars. Be the barista that can solve their problems or you can just be there to listen to their stories. 

Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is coming to you on April 20, 2023.

Check out the release trailer announcement
[previewyoutube=A3NMtiw0eZo;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s not so far off from now and we hope you are excited as we are. There are more that we would love to talk about, but to make things more interesting, we asked Dio Mahesa, the Art Director of Coffee Talk, what the players would expect in the second episode. 

“I’m excited to show you new interesting stories, new colorful characters with old characters from the prequel, and new drinks to explore! I hope you will enjoy the game.” 

Dio is proud of what has been produced for the past few months with the team, and he can’t wait to share more about his experience after the game releases. We can say that with certainty as we work behind the scenes with him, seeing all the new exciting content that will make the fans go wild after seeing how much things have been implemented. 

Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is a standalone visual novel game where you play as the barista in an alternative Seattle, where fantasy races are commonplace trying to make a living as a regular human does. Meet a diverse cast of characters – both old and new – listen to their stories, and serve them a warm drink or two. The way you serve would impact the overall story and how they will interact with you. Immerse yourself in the chill and cozy atmosphere of everyone’s favorite late-night coffee shop, Coffee Talk. 

Wishlist Coffee Talk Episode 2 on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

Follow us on social media and join our community to get into the latest updates of the game.  Please look forward to more teasers in the future as we are nearing the release date. We look forward to seeing your reaction to the upcoming news!

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː

notes.title: Stay Cozy in August with New Content Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/ab52af07e426b211b38c4e44c0a30c77f9bef7de.png

Hello everyone~ 

It’s already August, time flew so fast for all of us this year. Hopefully, you all are doing well and staying safe in the course of the pandemic. We here at Toge Productions are working our best, mostly working remotely from our homes, to bring you all more updates for the game! 


 New Localization: Indonesian 

As we are nearing the Indonesian Independence Day of August 17th and celebrating Indonesia's National Game Day (Hari Game Indonesia) on August 8th, we finally released the Indonesian language option in the game. We know that many of our fellow Indonesians have been waiting for this for so long. Please take a seat and enjoy the game.


Here’s a little sneak peek~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/20850a57ee51397737de26161f451f5cdddb9362.gif


 New songs added in-game! 
There are five new songs added, and now you can listen to them from Shuffld inside the game! Of course, all of them are made and covered by the one and only Andrew Jeremy. The songs added also take the theme from other games under Toge Productions. You can listen to some of the songs by clicking on the song title below.

 1. Distressed Last Call - Chillhop ver.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/dc4591d1664d789d087a0d9038a1ba420c6101bd.png
*The song is titled Last Call in-game.


 2. Bonfire Story - Chillhop Ver.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/50f814acb5a8a7f539d87e40137bc289f578ac36.png

 3. Taking a Break - Chillhop ver. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/3f4f63faf45cde8a5ca9732ba6509df88cd880a5.png

 4. The Past Around You - Chillhop ver.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/00ba5ee03729c3fd9d9f48e83bc14b6adc892c2d.png


 In summary, the updates for build v1.45 are as follows: 
- Indonesian localization
- 5 New songs were added in-game
- Improved UI/UX 
- Bug fixes

That’s all for now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b04803d97bba2e533ae8ee041af697b669218945.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/79dd3f2effac213f7a4d79409aa7b3a3427c939d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8b1312b21a87946f96f4f0f6eaabe151fe9fa95c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/84fedc2164e8a93f749f967a579a4dd488b8b784.png


Fully brewed with love~

Coffee Talk Team.

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!☕️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b2e0b40d0ef06762bd16168494ae3e05cd9fe5fb.png

We're getting a new small update for you guys. A yet another addition to our localization, the Brazilian Portuguese is now selectable in the Options menu. Please update your game to the latest version to select the new language!

We also have some minor fix on typos in the Russian translation, hoping that it'll further improve the experience and the immersion when playing. This also comes with some bug fixes that got reported to us, so we're really thankful to everyone that keeps helping us to improve the game be it feedback or bug report.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/f850dcd82f912afef154091a0dd9e0a507f67ce2.gif

Last but not least, our friend from Mojiken Studio is releasing When The Past Was Around on 22nd September. Please give some support to them by wishlishting or even buying the game!

Thank you for always being part in our game, also the tremendous amount of support and love that you guys always give to us.❤️

Cheers.
